**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/08/25 (Fri) 02:55
- [EVENT] User is looking for information on the 1972 Doubled Die Cent.
- [EVENT] User just got back from a local antique shop and scored a great deal on a vintage camera - a 1930s-era Zeiss Ikon.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The 1972 Doubled Die Cent is a highly sought-after error coin among collectors.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The estimated mintage of the 1972 Doubled Die Cent is around 250,000 to 500,000 coins.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The rarity of the 1972 Doubled Die Cent is due to the fact that the error was caught relatively early in the production process.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] A mint-state (MS) 1972 Doubled Die Cent can range from MS-60 to MS-68 on the Sheldon scale.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The value of a 1972 Doubled Die Cent can range from a few hundred dollars to over $10,000 depending on its condition.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To identify a 1972 Doubled Die Cent, look for a doubling of the "2" in the date and slight doubling of "LIBERTY" and "IN GOD WE TRUST."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Be cautious when purchasing a 1972 Doubled Die Cent, as counterfeits exist; buy from reputable dealers or have the coin authenticated.
